282172337.description:
Lot of 12 Antique Hemingray Glass Telegraph Telephone Line Insulators
This lot includes 12 antique glass telegraph and telephone line insulators, primarily Hemingray brand, featuring Hemingray-42 and Hemingray-17 markings. One insulator is marked H.G. CO. The colors include aqua/teal green and clear glass. Each insulator has a classic beehive or dome ribbed top and a threaded skirt base with embossed manufacturer names. The insulators show typical age-related wear such as bubbles, minor cracks, stress lines, and surface discoloration consistent with vintage glass from the early to mid 20th century. Sizes vary slightly but all are standard pin-type insulators used on utility poles. These insulators are suitable for collectors or display purposes.
14 x 10 x 5 in

282046416.description:
Large Rock Mineral Collection Bundle Good and Beautiful Educational Box
This large rock and mineral collection bundle includes the Good and Beautiful branded educational specimen box with 9 labeled compartments featuring igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic, and mineral samples such as mica, quartz, and pyrite. Also included is a French-labeled display case with 24 compartments containing various tumbled and raw stones like Microcline, Labradorite, Cornaline, Jaspe, Amazonite, Rhodonite, Calcite, Dolomie, Gabbro, and Apatite in a bamboo-framed glass-covered box. Additionally, there is a large loose assortment of approximately 40+ raw and polished stones and minerals, including lava rock, amethyst cluster, turquoise-colored stone, tiger's eye, petrified wood, onyx/calcite slab, rutilated quartz, and various jaspers and agates. Items show typical used and handled condition consistent with an educational or hobbyist rock collection. Specimens vary in size from small chips to palm-sized pieces. This collection is suitable for geology enthusiasts, collectors, or educational purposes.

Item Description:
Petrified Wood, Trochus Shell, Irridescent Ammonite, Agate Geodes, Opaline Glass
A natural history themed small collection in oranges, browns, whites, and iridescent tones, with a total weight of 9.9 oz. See list below for descriptions of each object:
1) a 3"x 2.5" x1" polished specimen of vibrant orange, red, white, brown petrified wood, with a barcode sticker on the bottom that reads "Petrified wood specimen" $16.99
2) a 2" x 2" spiral trochus shell, strawberry banded with red marks at the top section agatinst the white and nacre/iridescent sections.
3) a 1.5" x 1" sliced and polished spiral ammonite, beautifully defined in brown and grey sections; the reverse side is brown with iridescent nacre with an opal effect.
4) 2 small agatized and banded crystal geode halves, polished centers. One is 1" x 2" and the other is 2" x1.5". One is marbled black and brown and rust colors with white; one is lighter brown/yellow gold with darker brown rust colors banded with white.
5) A small polished piece of opaline glass, which appears a milky blue white, but throws vibrant orange shadows in the light, much like an actual opal.
6) a 1.5" x 1" flake of a bronze coppery metallic surface rock; the other side is rougher and more matte.
